newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Three killed in Tel Aviv blast - police.
newsitem.headline: Three killed in Tel Aviv blast - police.

text.p: At least three people were killed in an apparent suicide bombing at a Tel Aviv sidewalk cafe on Friday, Israel's Police Commissioner Assaf Hefetz said.

"Three are dead but it's not final," he told Reuters. "We have 30 to 40 wounded, most of them lightly." He also said: "It's a high probability that it was a suicide bombing." One of the three dead could be the bomber, he added.
